reward_model.training_data: BTS, campaign=all, raw position=1, rows before the frozen temporal boundary only

features.user_features: All raw user_feature_* columns, one-hot encoded with categories learned on BTS training only; unknown evaluation categories map to all-zero indicators for that field.
features.item_context: Archived item_context.csv features for candidate action. item_feature_0 is numeric; remaining item_feature_* fields are treated as categorical and one-hot encoded with training/catalog-derived categories only.
features.user_item_affinity: Exactly one scalar candidate-action affinity: user-item_affinity_{a} when scoring action a. Do not include affinities for non-candidate actions in q(x,a).
features.numeric_scaling: Standardize numeric item_feature_0 and candidate affinity using BTS-training means and standard deviations only. Zero-variance numeric features are left unscaled after centering conventionally by setting scale=1.
features.interactions: No additional interactions or polynomial features.
features.missing_values: Categorical missing values become a literal __MISSING__ level learned from training; numeric missing values are imputed with the BTS-training median before scaling.

candidate_scoring.challenger_rule: 0.90 on the action with largest frozen q_hat plus 0.10/80 on every archived action; exact ties choose the lowest item_id.
candidate_scoring.evaluation_batching: Candidate actions may be scored in deterministic batches for memory control; batching must not change arithmetic or policy probabilities.

bootstrap.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over evaluation rows ordered by timestamp

no_post_outcome_tuning: Do not change C, solver, preprocessing, epsilon, split, target support, estimator, clipping rule, or bootstrap settings after evaluation outcomes are read.
If convergence fails at max_iter=200, report model-fit failure rather than increasing max_iter after inspecting policy-value results.
outcome_visibility: This implementation lock was created before reading or aggregating evaluation-period click outcomes.
